title: Saray Labinsakey a Bitewen ya Inmabeba
intro: Sakey a pigura manlapud Quran so naikdan na aralem a pasingawey nen ugaw ni — sakey a kugip na saray celestial a bengatla ya onyuko bilang panangigalang. Pigaran taon so onlabas ed panagtraidor, panagsian, palson akusasyon, tan panagpriso sakbay a nagawa iyan pasingawey. Siopa iyan mabiskeg a kamarerwa ya say istorya to so walad sankaaruman a kapitulo na Quran?
clues: Ugaw ak ni, abendisyonan na sakey a makapadinayew a kugip ya anggan say mismon amak so amasakbay ed siak ya ag ko ibaga.
Saray mismon agagik, ya abulag lapud imon, et nankokomplot ira sumpad siak tan impelag da ak ed aralem tan ambilunget a bobon.
Inawit da ak ed arawin bansa tan inlako da ak ed sankaabungan na sakey a gagalangen ya opisyal, a ditan et akaromog ak na pabor tan inmatagey so responsabilidad ko.
Say palson akusasyon so angitonton ed agmakatunongan ya inkipriso ko, balet diad saman ya ambilunget a pasen et akaromog ak na ligliwa ed pikakasi tan panagtalimukor ed si Allah.

Binendisyonan ak nen Allah na matalag ya abilidad ya mangiter na kabaliksan ed saray kugip, ya diad kaunoran et angitonton ed siak ed manuley na bansa tan intagey to ak ed atagey a posisyon na panagmatalek.

Kayari na andukey a taon na inkaapag-apag mi, akapinengnengan ko lamet so inad-arok a pamilya, tan say kugip ko nen ugaw ak ni ya walay labin sakey a bitewen, say banwa, tan say bulan ya ontalimukor ed siak et asumpal la.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Propeta Yusuf
Propeta Salih
Propeta Ilyas
Si Tubba', say manuley na Himyar nensaman
Sakey a mapaabeban pastol a nanlapud pukdol na Palestina

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say pangibantak ed aralem tan ambilunget a bobon na saray maimon ya agagi
Say inakmon na sakey a baleg a pinalsa ed aralem a dayat
Say pangibantak ed mandarlang ya apoy na saray managdayew ed idolo
Say pakaandi na madibinon dagem na kadederal
Akaliktar ed baleg a delap ya anampot ed interon dalin
trial.answer: Say pangibantak ed aralem tan ambilunget a bobon na saray maimon ya agagi

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey ya amagan bobon ed desierto ya diman ak tinaynan
Sakey a baleg a sira ed aralem a dayat
Sakey a baleg a biong ya impaalagey unong ed ganggan na Dios
Sakey a tori ya impaalagey pian makasabi ed tawen
Sakey a sagradon apoy ya ag labay ya poolan
location.answer: Sakey ya amagan bobon ed desierto ya diman ak tinaynan

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Akapiulop lamet ed pamilya kayari na dakel a taon ya insian tan nagmaliw ya napanmatalkan a ministro
Indaulo so baleg ya iyalis na totook ed biek na dayat
Pinasakbayan ko so bansak ed onsasabin kadederal ya manguupot ed sikara
Angipaalagey na sagradon abung ya nagmaliw a santuaryo na amin
Maligen ya pinmaway ed eges na sakey a baleg a pinalsa kayari na taloy agew
outcome.answer: Akapiulop lamet ed pamilya kayari na dakel a taon ya insian tan nagmaliw ya napanmatalkan a ministro

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
